description: Find and study Eastern Orthodox sources, from everyday questions to detailed research; check quotations, references, and editions.

defaultPrompt: What is the Orthodox position on going to a casino?
Study 2 Peter 1:4 through Scripture, Fathers, councils, and liturgy. Give contextual readings, editions, and precise references.
Trace the saying attributed to Chrysostom about hell paved with skulls. Compare variants, dated witnesses, and primary passages.
interface.longDescription: Explore Eastern Orthodox sources for everyday questions and detailed research. Brief reading lists aim for eight useful sources, with fewer for limited evidence or narrow questions, and offer another search. Linked sources and precise locations come first. Verify Christian quotations and references. When ecclesial standing is actually at issue, receive a concise spelled-out assessment with linked warrants. Fuller explanation is available when requested. Three self-contained skills; no MCP server or external account dependency.

name: orthodox-source-study
